title: SDG 16-2-2: Victims of Human Trafficking
description: Number of victims of human trafficking per 100,000 population by sex, age, and form of exploitation, as per the specifications of SDG Indicator 16-2-2.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: type
fields.title: Type of Exploitation
fields.description: [Categorical] All forms of trafficking ('all'), human trafficking for forced labour, servitude and slavery ('forced_labour'), or human trafficking for sexual exploitation ('sexual_exploitation')

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: age
fields.title: Age Group
fields.description: [Categorical] Either all ages ('all'), individuals less than 18 years old ('18_below'), or individuals aged 18 and above ('18_and_above')

fields.name: value
fields.title: Victims per 100,000 Population
fields.description: [Float] The number of victims of human trafficking per 100,000 population of that sex and age group

methodology: This dataset is produced based on ground-level surveillance coordinated by the Council for Anti-Trafficking in Persons and Anti-Smuggling of Migrants, which is tasked with implementing and coordinating national security policies and programmes on the aspects of trafficking in persons and smuggling of migrants. Besides for operational purposes, this data is reported as part of Malaysia's monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in line with the most recent [SDG Global Indicator Framework](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sdg.pdf).
caveat: The data is subject to revision in future updates.
